home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.name: Hard-anodised Frying Pan
home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.description: A 24 cm frying pan with a hard-anodised aluminium body and a stay-cool handle. Wash by hand with a soft sponge and use wooden or silicone tools.

reviews.body: Heats evenly and eggs slide off easily. The handle stays cool on a medium flame.
Good weight and finish. Arrived well wrapped, though the box was slightly dented.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.name: Stainless Steel Pressure Cooker
home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.description: A 5 litre stainless steel pressure cooker with a flat induction-ready base and a lid with a safety valve. Check the rubber gasket regularly and wash the lid by hand.

reviews.body: Whistles properly and cooks dal in minutes. The base works fine on our induction plate.
Sturdy build and easy to clean. Wish the handles were a little longer.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.name: Cast Iron Tawa
home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.description: A 28 cm pre-seasoned cast iron tawa with a long handle for rotis and parathas. Dry it fully after washing and rub with a little oil before storing.

reviews.body: Rotis puff up nicely and the tawa holds heat for a long time. Quite heavy but that is expected.
Works well, but the surface was a bit rough at first and needed a few rounds of oiling.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.name: Tri-ply Kadai with Lid
home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.description: A 3 litre tri-ply stainless steel kadai with a glass lid and two riveted side handles. Suitable for gas and induction, and safe to wash with regular dish soap.

reviews.body: Perfect size for family sabzi and deep frying. Nothing sticks if the oil is hot first.
Looks smart and feels solid. The glass lid fits snugly.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.name: Non-stick Idli Maker
home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.description: A four-tier idli stand with a non-stick coated base that makes sixteen idlis per batch. Fits a standard 4 litre pot, and the plates should be cleaned with a soft cloth.

reviews.body: Idlis come out soft and release without fuss. The stand is light and easy to lift.
Neat design and the handle is comfortable. Delivered in two days with good packaging.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.name: Aluminium Milk Pan
home-kitchen-kitchenware-cookware.description: A 1.5 litre aluminium milk pan with a pouring lip and a long heat-resistant handle. Small enough for daily tea and warming milk on a gas stove.

reviews.body: Handy for the morning chai. The pouring lip really does not drip.
Light, simple and good value. Cleans up easily with a scrub.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.name: Ceramic Dinner Set 18 Piece
home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.description: An 18 piece ceramic dinner set with plates, bowls and side plates in a plain glossy white finish. Dishwasher and microwave safe, serves six people.

reviews.body: Clean white look and the glaze is smooth. Every piece arrived intact in thick foam.
Nice set for the price. Plates are a little thinner than I expected.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.name: Stainless Steel Thali Set
home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.description: A six piece thali set with a large plate, four small katoris and a glass in polished stainless steel. Rust resistant and easy to wash by hand or in a dishwasher.

reviews.body: Solid steel with a mirror shine. Katori sizes are just right for dal and sabzi.
Looks traditional and feels sturdy. Edges are smooth and finished well.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.name: Melamine Kids Plate Set
home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.description: A four piece melamine set with a plate, bowl, cup and spoon in bright colours. Lightweight and hard to break, but not for use in a microwave.

reviews.body: My son drops things all the time and these have survived so far. Colours are cheerful.
Light and the right size for a small child. Print is slightly less sharp than the photo.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.name: Hand-painted Serving Bowl
home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.description: A 24 cm stoneware serving bowl with a hand-painted blue floral pattern. Suitable for salads and curries, and best washed by hand to protect the design.

reviews.body: Each bowl has small brush variations, which gives it character. Great for serving at gatherings.
Pretty bowl but one side had a tiny glaze bubble. Still usable.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.name: Borosilicate Glass Mug Set
home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.description: A set of six 300 ml borosilicate glass mugs that handle both hot and cold drinks. Clear and plain, and safe to wash in a dishwasher.

reviews.body: Crystal clear glass and comfortable handles. Wrapped individually so nothing cracked.
Good for tea and cold coffee alike. The size is generous.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.name: Copper Water Bottle
home-kitchen-kitchenware-dinnerware.description: A 1 litre copper bottle with a screw cap and a hammered outer finish. Rinse with water after use and wipe dry, and do not put in a dishwasher.

reviews.body: Looks lovely on the table and the cap seals tightly with no leaks in my bag.
Well made with a nice hammered texture. Arrived polished and carefully packed.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.name: Airtight Plastic Jar Set
home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.description: A set of six airtight jars in 500 ml, 750 ml and 1 litre sizes with clear walls and snap-on lids. Made from food-grade plastic, suitable for dry pantry items.

reviews.body: Lids click shut firmly and the stackable shape saves shelf space. Clear walls make it easy to see what is inside.
Good set for the pantry. Labels are not included so I added my own.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.name: Stainless Steel Lunch Box
home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.description: A three container stainless steel tiffin with a carry handle and a leak-resistant lid. Each container holds about 350 ml and can be washed by hand.

reviews.body: Carried it to the office all week with no spills. The steel feels thick and well finished.
Compact and tidy to pack. Handle clip is a little stiff at first.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.name: Glass Storage Containers
home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.description: A set of four borosilicate glass containers with bamboo-effect lids in 400 ml to 1 litre sizes. Oven and freezer safe without the lids.

reviews.body: Perfect for leftovers and reheating. The glass is thick and the lids fit snugly.
Looks premium and does not hold onto smells. Slightly heavy to carry around.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.name: Rotating Spice Rack
home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.description: A round rotating spice organiser with twelve small jars and a spoon holder. Sits on a counter and the jars can be rinsed under tap water.

reviews.body: Saves so much time while cooking, and all the masalas are within reach. Turns smoothly.
Handy, but the jar lids are a bit tight to open at first.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.name: Bread Box with Bamboo Lid
home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.description: A large steel bread box with a sliding bamboo lid that fits a full loaf. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and keep away from direct water.

reviews.body: Looks tidy on the counter and the lid slides without catching. Fits our bigger loaf easily.
Neat finish and simple to clean. Arrived within three days.

home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.name: Collapsible Silicone Container
home-kitchen-kitchenware-storage-contain.description: A 900 ml silicone food container that folds flat for storage, with a vented snap lid. Microwave and dishwasher safe, and handy for travel.

reviews.body: Folds down to almost nothing, so it takes no room in the bag. The lid seals well.
Clever design and easy to wash. We use it for picnics.

home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.name: Cotton Cushion Cover Set
home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.description: A set of five 40 x 40 cm cushion covers in plain woven cotton with a hidden zip. Machine washable in cold water, inserts sold separately.

reviews.body: Soft fabric and the colours match the photos. Zips run smoothly.
Good value for five covers. Slight creases on arrival but they went after a wash.

home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.name: Velvet Floor Cushion
home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.description: A 60 x 60 cm floor cushion with a soft velvet cover and a firm fibre filling. Spot clean the cover and keep it away from damp areas.

reviews.body: Great for sitting on the living room floor. Plush feel and holds its shape.
Rich colour and well stitched. A bit bulky to move around.

home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.name: Block Print Cushion Cover
home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.description: A 45 x 45 cm cushion cover with a hand block printed pattern on cotton canvas. Wash separately for the first time and iron on low heat.

reviews.body: The print is crisp and looks handmade. Adds colour to our plain sofa.
Pretty pattern. The fabric is firm and the stitching is neat.

home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.name: Boho Tassel Cushion
home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.description: A 40 cm square cushion with cotton tassels on all four corners and a woven geometric design. Comes with a filled insert and a removable cover.

reviews.body: Cute tassels and it comes already filled, so no extra buying. Good size for a bed.
Looks like it costs more than it does. Delivery was quick.

home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.name: Round Jute Cushion
home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.description: A 45 cm round cushion with a natural jute cover and a soft polyester filling. Brush lightly to clean and avoid soaking.

reviews.body: Earthy look that suits our balcony chairs. The shape stays round.
Nice texture, but the jute feels a little scratchy against bare arms.

home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.name: Embroidered Bolster Cushion
home-kitchen-home-decor-cushions.description: A 45 cm long cylindrical bolster with floral embroidery and a cotton cover. The insert is firm and the cover can be hand washed.

reviews.body: Embroidery is fine and neat. Great as a back rest on the diwan.
Looks traditional and elegant. Firmness is just right for me.

home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.name: Framed Abstract Canvas Print
home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.description: A 60 x 40 cm abstract canvas print in a slim wooden frame, ready to hang with a fitted hook. Wipe with a dry cloth and keep out of damp areas.

reviews.body: Colours are rich and the frame looks solid. Hung it in our hallway in five minutes.
Pretty print for the price. The packaging with cardboard corners worked well.

home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.name: Wooden Wall Shelf Set
home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.description: A set of three floating wall shelves in engineered wood with a matte walnut finish. Each shelf holds light decor items and comes with fixing screws.

reviews.body: Easy to fit and holds my plants well. Finish looks even.
Clean design. Drill bit was not included so keep one ready.

home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.name: Metal Wall Clock
home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.description: A 50 cm round wall clock with a black metal frame and bold numerals. Runs on one AA battery and has a quiet sweep movement.

reviews.body: Easy to read from across the room and no ticking sound at night.
Looks smart and keeps good time. Battery not included.

home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.name: Macrame Wall Hanging
home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.description: A 70 cm long macrame wall hanging made of cotton cord on a wooden rod. Hangs with a jute loop, and dust can be brushed off lightly.

reviews.body: Handmade feel and tidy knots. Brightens up a blank wall behind my bed.
Looks nice, but it came a bit crushed and needed shaping by hand.

home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.name: Set of Three Botanical Prints
home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.description: Three 30 x 40 cm botanical prints on matte paper with black frames and plastic glass. Sold as a set, and each frame can hang upright or sideways.

reviews.body: Nice together as a trio on the stairway wall. Prints are sharp.
Frames feel better than expected. All three arrived without a scratch.

home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.name: Brass Mandala Wall Plate
home-kitchen-home-decor-wall-art.description: A 30 cm decorative wall plate in brass with an etched mandala pattern. Polish gently with a dry cloth to keep the shine.

reviews.body: Warm golden tone and the etching is detailed. Adds a festive touch to our entryway.
Good weight and finish. Hook at the back is firm.

home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.name: Ceramic Table Lamp
home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.description: A 35 cm table lamp with a glazed ceramic base and a cream fabric shade. Takes a standard E27 bulb, sold separately.

reviews.body: Gives a soft glow in the bedroom. The base is heavy so it does not tip.
Elegant look and smooth switch. Cable is a little short.

home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.name: Bamboo Floor Lamp
home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.description: A 150 cm floor lamp with a bamboo stand and a woven shade, with a foot switch. Needs assembly with the included screws.

reviews.body: Sets the mood in our reading corner. Assembly took ten minutes.
Looks great and stable. The shade came a touch dusty, but it wiped clean.

home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.name: Rechargeable Study Lamp
home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.description: A foldable LED desk lamp with three brightness levels and a USB charging cable. A full charge lasts several hours at the lowest setting.

reviews.body: Perfect for late homework sessions. Brightness levels are easy to switch.
Bright and light to move around. The arm holds position well.

home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.name: Brass Diya Lamp
home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.description: A traditional 12 cm brass diya with a wide base and a small handle for use with oil and cotton wicks. Wash with warm water and a mild soap after cooling.

reviews.body: Good heavy brass and a lovely shine. We use it every evening for pooja.
Nicely made and stable. Came in a neat gift box.

home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.name: Rattan Pendant Light
home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.description: A 40 cm hanging pendant shade woven from natural rattan, with a 1.2 metre cord. The bulb holder is included and the bulb is not.

reviews.body: Casts beautiful patterns on the ceiling at night. Weave is neat and even.
Lovely shade but the cord was shorter than I hoped for our high ceiling.

home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.name: Solar Garden String Lights
home-kitchen-home-decor-lamps.description: A 10 metre string of warm white LED lights with a small solar panel and a battery pack. Turns on at dusk and is meant for balconies and gardens.

reviews.body: Looks pretty on our balcony railing. The solar panel charges well on a sunny day.
Easy to put up and bright enough for the evening. Packed neatly without tangles.

home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.name: Cotton Double Bedsheet Set
home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.description: A double bedsheet set with one flat sheet and two pillow covers in 144 thread count cotton. Machine wash at 30 degrees and iron on medium heat.

reviews.body: Soft after the first wash and the print has not faded. Fits our double bed well.
Good everyday sheet. Pillow covers are a bit snug on large pillows.

home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.name: Fitted Sheet King Size
home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.description: A king size fitted sheet in brushed microfibre with deep elastic corners for mattresses up to 10 inches thick. Machine washable and quick to dry.

reviews.body: Stays tight all night and does not slip off the corners. Smooth to touch.
Fits our thick mattress properly. The colour is a shade lighter than shown.

home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.name: Single Bed Kids Bedsheet
home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.description: A single bedsheet with one pillow cover in cotton blend with a printed animal design. Machine washable, and the bright colours should be washed separately.

reviews.body: My daughter loves the print and it is soft enough for her. Washes well.
Good size for a single bed. Delivery was on time.

home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.name: Jaipuri Print Bedsheet
home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.description: A double bedsheet with two pillow covers in cotton with a traditional hand-block style floral print. Wash in cold water the first time to keep the dye in place.

reviews.body: Beautiful print and it feels cool in summer. Many compliments from guests.
Lovely design, though a little dye came out in the first wash. Fine after that.

home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.name: Satin Finish Bedsheet
home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.description: A queen size bedsheet with two pillow covers in smooth satin-finish polyester. Wash on a gentle cycle and iron on a low setting.

reviews.body: Has a nice sheen and feels smooth. A bit slippery on the mattress at first.
Looks luxurious and arrived neatly folded in a zip bag.

home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.name: Linen Blend Bedsheet
home-kitchen-bedding-bedsheets.description: A queen size flat sheet and two pillow covers in a cotton and linen blend with a relaxed textured weave. Gets softer with each wash.

reviews.body: Breathable and airy. The natural texture looks great in our bedroom.
Wrinkles easily, but that is part of the look. Well stitched.

home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.name: Fleece Throw Blanket
home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.description: A 130 x 180 cm throw blanket in soft polyester fleece with finished edges. Machine washable and quick to dry.

reviews.body: Very soft and light. Perfect for the sofa on cool evenings.
Nice colour and no shedding after washing. Slightly thinner than expected.

home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.name: Reversible Cotton Dohar
home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.description: A double size dohar in two layers of cotton with a different print on each side. Light enough for mild nights and washable at home.

reviews.body: Just right for the AC season. Two designs in one blanket is a nice touch.
Soft and well stitched. It shrank a tiny bit after the first wash.

home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.name: Quilted Winter Razai
home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.description: A double bed razai with a quilted cotton cover and a thick polyester fill. Air it in the sun now and then and dry clean when needed.

reviews.body: Warm and cosy through the Delhi winter, yet not too heavy.
Pattern is attractive and stitching is even. Arrived compressed but fluffed up in a day.

home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.name: Woollen Blend Blanket
home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.description: A double size blanket in a wool and acrylic blend with a plain weave and a satin border. Dry clean or hand wash gently in cool water.

reviews.body: Dense weave and good for chilly nights. The border looks smart.
Warm enough, but it has a mild odour for the first few days until aired.

home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.name: Muslin Baby Blanket
home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.description: A 100 x 100 cm baby blanket in four layers of soft muslin cotton. Pre-washed, and suitable for gentle machine washing.

reviews.body: Very soft and gets softer with washing. We use it for carrying outside too.
Lovely pastel shade and a good size. Came in a cute cloth bag.

home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.name: Travel Blanket with Pouch
home-kitchen-bedding-blankets.description: A lightweight 120 x 150 cm blanket that folds into a small zip pouch with a carry loop. Made of polyester and easy to wash.

reviews.body: Packs small and fits in my backpack. Handy on trains and flights.
Compact and soft enough. The pouch zip works smoothly.

home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.name: Microfibre Bed Pillow
home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.description: A standard 45 x 70 cm pillow with a soft microfibre fill and a cotton cover. Fluff daily and wash the cover separately.

reviews.body: Soft but holds shape through the night. Good value for a pair.
Comfortable and not too flat. Took a day to fully puff up.

home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.name: Memory Foam Pillow
home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.description: A contoured pillow made of memory foam with a removable cotton cover. The cover can be machine washed, and the foam should be wiped clean.

reviews.body: Firm and supportive shape. There is a slight smell at first that fades in a day.
Cover feels nice and the pillow keeps its shape. Delivered on time.

home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.name: Cotton Filled Pillow
home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.description: A traditional pillow filled with soft cotton and stitched in a striped cotton cover. Sun it every few weeks to keep it fresh.

reviews.body: Reminds me of the old home-made ones, firm and cosy.
Good stitching and decent weight. A little firm for my taste.

home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.name: Neck Roll Pillow
home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.description: A 40 cm cylindrical neck roll with a polyester fill and a zippered cotton cover. Can be used as a travel or sofa cushion.

reviews.body: Compact and handy for travel. The zip cover is easy to take off.
Firm roll that stays in place on the bed. Good build.

home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.name: Kids Cartoon Pillow
home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.description: A small 30 x 40 cm pillow with a printed cartoon cover and a soft hollow fibre fill. Light and easy to wash by machine.

reviews.body: My kid took it to bed the same day. Print is bright and the size is perfect.
Cute design, but it is smaller than I imagined from the picture.

home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.name: Hotel Style Gel Fibre Pillow
home-kitchen-bedding-pillows.description: A plush 50 x 75 cm pillow with a gel fibre filling and a smooth cotton shell. Fluffy and soft, and should be dried fully after washing.

reviews.body: Plump and fluffy like the ones in a nice stay. Looks great on the bed.
Cover is soft and stitching is tidy. Good size for a king bed.
